$comment: Input for the launch-board skill. Committed on purpose: it holds no secrets and no copy.
The password lives in the environment, the channel list and every post body live in the board.
The panel is a port, not a copy: this repo's site is static, so the Next.js route handlers
became Vercel functions under landing/api/ and the React panel became one self-contained page.
$goalNote: Ranked by the owner: 1 stars, 2 awareness, 3 installs. Stars is primary, so the copy leads with the engineering (a private CoreBrightness API called from JavaScript, no native build step) rather than with the install line.

product.name: macos-keyboard-backlight
product.oneLiner: Control the MacBook keyboard backlight from the command line or Node.

channels.$: Proposed in stage 3 from goal and audiences, then cut down with the owner. The names live here; every rule, title and body lives in the board.

assets.$formatsNote: 9:16 is dropped: there is no short-form video channel in the plan, and the product is a keyboard seen from above, which crops badly to vertical.
assets.$narratedVideoNote: The two committed GIFs (assets/demo.gif, assets/pulse.gif) already carry the demo, and both are Remotion renders from video/. Revisit if a YouTube or Product Hunt slot is added.

hooks.$: beforePost is the one that earns its keep: it asserts the live site answers 200 and the package still passes its smoke test before a link goes into a thread that cannot be edited.
